capabilities: share, update, and unshare individual notes to a self-hosted server
rotate share links and gate pages with generated passcodes
upload attachments content-addressed and convert wikilinks between shared notes
edit and push the public site's CSS, JS, and head HTML from plugin settings
manage all shares from an in-app list with copy, rotate, and delete actions
extras: The manifest warns the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The server must be reachable over HTTPS behind a reverse proxy and configured via environment variables; troubleshooting covers Docker exits, render delays for dynamic content, theme pushes, and rate-limit behavior behind proxies.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish single notes on demand to a self-hosted server with unguessable links, passcodes, and automatic re-publishing after edits.

relations.evidence: Litestream works for continuous replication of the database file.

requires.name: API key shared with the server

summary: Self-hosted publishing that shares individual notes to your own domain via a Go server, with link rotation, passcodes, and site theming.
